description: as nhflow_3d_net_wall_dyn, the dynamic bar net (X 320 13) written to the LAGOON store (P 18 1) every 10 steps: REEF3D_NHFLOW.lagoon with the particle set nhflow_net, the knots with Tension, Velocity and Acceleration (net_barDyn::print writes its .vtk files to REEF3D_CFD_6DOF_Net, which an NHFLOW run does not make: its nets were seen only through the store). The solution is that of the case without the store.
covers: lagoon_nets with a dynamic net (net_barDyn::print: Velocity, Acceleration)
